title: Cut agent token cost: mid-step relay, 44k baseline, Opus leaks
body:
Outcome: agent sessions on this host stop paying for oversized context: no session runs past the relay threshold, Opus runs only where chosen, and a fresh session starts well below ~44k tokens.
Evidence (operator usage audit 2026-11-09, API-price estimates, not per account): 794 sessions, ~104k requests, active 150 of 168 h/week, ~9 concurrent sessions; Opus ~89% of cost; requests above 200k context ~39% of cost; 44 sessions passed 300k (~20%), 8 reached 964k (~11%) because context-relay measures only after a finished step, so one long step crosses the threshold without a handoff; ekologus-wp-local agents frontend-artist and slice-reviewer pin model: opus (~9% of cost); some general-purpose subagents ran on Opus despite CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet (cause unknown); cswap auto does not rotate accounts, so account 3 hit 100%; a fresh session starts at ~44k tokens resent on every request.
Acceptance: (1) the context check fires during a step, not only after it (a PreToolUse/PostToolUse measurement that forces handoff at the threshold), proven by a transcript replay that crosses it mid-step; (2) the 44k baseline is broken down by source (system prompt, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, memory index, skills listing, MCP tools) and the KRN-owned share cut; (3) the subagent-model override cause is found from transcripts with a reproduction; (4) out-of-repo items (ekologus agents pinned to opus, cswap auto rotation, global skills) are listed with a decision-ready proposal for the operator, since they sit outside KRN scope and global config.
Note: operator asked to take this on after t-wm22s14 (2026-11-09).

Acceptance 1 evidence (#456, 724ded0): scripts/claude/context-replay.ts replays a transcript through the real gauge hook; fixture test proves the advisory lands mid-step (243k, step ended 273k). KRN transcript peaks: 966k before the PostToolUse gauge (2026-10-29), at most 343k since; other projects without the gauge still reach 964-967k. Host replay of 77 transcripts over 300k: .krn/runs/token-audit/mid-step-replay.jsonl (running detached, done when .krn/runs/token-audit/replay.done exists). First 10: every first advisory fired mid-step at 240-242k, but steps ran on to 260-368k, so an advisory alone does not stop a long step; next slice: a forcing check (repeat or PreToolUse refusal above a ceiling) plus a host-wide gauge install proposal for the operator (global hooks need hook trust).

Acceptance 1 forcing check: context-gauge repeats the second advisory every 10k of growth and, past 90% of autoCompactWindow, a PreToolUse hook refuses Agent/Task/Workflow/WebFetch/WebSearch/NotebookEdit and Write/Edit outside .krn/ and ~/.claude/projects (Bash, Read, Skill stay open for krn-handoff). Proof: test/claude/context-replay.test.ts refuses an Agent call at 243k inside the step that reached 273k; host replay of the 5 transcripts over 360k: .krn/runs/token-audit/ceiling-replay.jsonl.

Ceiling replay (ecd3791, .krn/runs/token-audit/ceiling-replay.jsonl, 5 transcripts over 360k): the ceiling refused 1-42 calls, but first refusals landed at 360-476k because sessions grow past the ceiling through Bash and Read, which stay open for the handoff. Next: past the ceiling, refuse Bash commands outside a handoff allowlist (krn state, krn task, git, handoff-requests, operator-inbox, successor-launch) and cap Read output, proven by the same replay.

Handoff-only ceiling: past 90% the gauge admits only Skill, ToolSearch, Bash built from handoff commands (cd, echo, krn, git, node scripts/claude/{handoff-requests,operator-inbox,successor-launch}.ts, no substitutions), reads and writes under .krn/ or memory, and Read with limit <= 200; every other tool is refused. Replay (.krn/runs/token-audit/ceiling-bash-replay.jsonl, 6 transcripts over 360k at a 400k window, ceiling 360k; PreToolUse now evaluated in process): first refusal at 360-365k in all six (was 360-477k), refusals 10-467, admitted handoff calls 0-13. Remaining for acceptance 1: host-wide gauge install proposal (hook trust); then acceptance 4, 2, 3.
